title: Renewable energy & economic growth
short: A cross-country study of renewable-energy investment and economic growth, using an augmented Solow model.
description: This paper adds renewable-energy investment to an augmented Solow growth model. It uses cross-country data from Penn World Table, the World Bank, IRENA and educational-attainment datasets, comparing different specifications and investment measures. The research paper, summary and SRC presentation are included below.

title: Health & livelihoods
short: Household facilities and treatment expenditure, studied using NSS health data, descriptive tables and regressions.
description: A group project on the relationship between household amenities and health expenditure using NSS 71st-round data. We looked at cooking fuel, drainage and latrine facilities, with comparisons between public and private treatment. The report, descriptive tables and regression analysis are included below.
credits: Neha, Vighnesh, Saranyan, Vaibhav and Vijayshree.

title: Data visualisation
short: A colour-blind-friendly visualisation poster and a Python notebook of charts, maps and plotting experiments.
description: A poster exploring colour-blind-friendly charts, alongside a Python visualisation notebook. The notebook includes statistical plots, maps, colour experiments and chart layouts using matplotlib, seaborn, Plotly and GeoPandas. Many examples use generated data for plotting practice.
notes: The notebook includes unfinished experiments and saved errors. Interactive plots are available in the original .ipynb file.

title: Jharkhand PDS web scraping
short: A Python notebook for extracting and cleaning a public-distribution table from the Jharkhand government website.
description: This notebook collects a block-level public-distribution report using Requests and BeautifulSoup, then cleans and structures the table with pandas. It covers row extraction, column naming, whitespace removal and numeric conversion. A later section explores an Excel workbook with openpyxl.
notes: The Excel section requires Bokaro.xlsx, which is not included. The scraper has not been retested against the live website.

title: Crime data: categorisation & interpretation
short: A group booklet comparing crime-data categories and visualisations for Assam, Gujarat, Kerala and Punjab.
description: A 62-page group project examining crime-data categories and how they are presented. It includes comparisons across Assam, Gujarat, Kerala and Punjab, word-frequency displays and colour-blind-friendly graphics, followed by a discussion of categorisation and reporting.

title: India & China: development comparisons
short: A two-page historical timeline and two data assignments comparing social indicators, employment and economic change.
description: A visual timeline of ideas and events in India and China, accompanied by two comparative data assignments. The assignments examine life expectancy, fertility, schooling, sectoral employment and output, using time-series charts and regressions.

title: Water-pricing replication
short: A replication report covering Tables 1–8 of a study on irrigation pricing and water conservation.
description: A replication exercise based on “Inefficient water pricing and incentives for conservation” by Ujjayant Chakravorty, Manzoor H. Dar and Kyle Emerick (2019). The report works through Tables 1–8, including treatment interactions, fixed effects and village-clustered standard errors.
credits: Replication report: Vaibhav Agarwal. Original study: Ujjayant Chakravorty, Manzoor H. Dar and Kyle Emerick.
notes: The report is included; the replication dataset and scripts are not.

title: Education & wages
short: An analysis of education and weekly earnings across employment groups, using PLFS 2018–19 data.
description: A computational economics paper on education and weekly earnings among salaried, self-employed and casual workers. It uses PLFS 2018–19 data, with rural–urban comparisons, regression controls and interaction terms. Maps and grouped charts accompany the regression tables.

title: Renewable-energy finance
short: A paper comparing renewable-energy funding by region, income group and financing instrument.
description: A study of renewable-energy finance using IRENA investment data and World Bank income classifications and GDP measures. It compares loans, grants and equity across regions and income groups, with maps and tables covering India, China and African countries.

title: Piotroski stock scoring
short: A group Python notebook that retrieves company statements and calculates a Piotroski-style financial score.
description: A coursework implementation of Piotroski-style stock scoring. The notebook retrieves financial statements with yfinance and uses accounting ratios and conditional rules to build a score. Explanations sit alongside the corresponding Python calculations.
notes: This is a coursework draft, not a validated F-score implementation. It uses positional statement indexing and repeats the same average-assets expression for both periods.

title: Carbon capture in India
short: An illustrated presentation and report on carbon capture, utilisation and storage in Indian industry.
description: A group review of carbon capture, utilisation and storage in India. The report covers capture technologies, industrial applications, costs and environmental and social considerations. The presentation uses diagrams and illustrations to introduce the topic.

title: Rajasthan suicide data story
short: A visual data story exploring reported suicide patterns in Rajasthan through comparisons, maps and literature.
description: An exploratory data story about reported suicide patterns in Rajasthan. It brings together comparative indicators, maps and literature in a written report.
notes: The cultural explanation discussed in the paper is exploratory, not an established causal finding.
